name: rust-coverage
//: The Rust line floor: `cargo llvm-cov report --fail-under-lines 95` over every Rust crate's instrumented `test` run (each leaves its merged profile in target/coverage/<record>.profdata). Selected through its inputs whenever Rust source or a Rust test changes, never through graph edges, so it depends on no e2e project. Skipped on Windows, where llvm-cov does not attribute subprocess-spawned binary coverage.

commands: bash scripts/rust-coverage.sh oneharness-core oneharness oneharness-integration oneharness-mock-harness oneharness-e2e oneharness-history-compat oneharness-sdk-contract oneharness-sdk-conformance
